messages:
olivia-billing: Sierra Studios (acct: sierra-001) — INV-2026-1145 is overdue for $12,450 (due 2026-03-05). They emailed asking to split into 3 installments and asked we keep Dedicated instances running for their campaign this week. Any objections to offering a partial today + 2 installments? cc @anya-cs

marco-payments: Can you paste the bank/ACH trace? Last payment had an R01 return. If we do split, recommend 30% now then 35/35. Also would like a signed payment addendum and a processing fee note.

anya-cs: Campaign goes live Fri — if we pull infra it's going to break their rollout. Customer told our AE they'd make a partial payment today if we accept the plan. Happy to own the PM side and collect proof of payment. :pray:

finance-bot: *Dunning status:* Stage 2 — automated reminder scheduled in 48h. Outstanding: $12,450. Recent activity: invoice sent 2026-02-28.

julian-legal: We can draft a short installment addendum that authorizes automated debits on dates and adds a processing clause. Suggest 2% fee or waive in exchange for immediate partial payment today. Need customer's e-signature before we mark as fulfilled. If we don't get partial by EOD + no signed addendum by Monday, recommend placing account on credit hold.

micah-cfo: Approve a one-time 0% processing fee on the condition that CS confirms a verified partial payment today and legal gets the signed addendum by Monday COB. If either condition fails, put account on hold and escalate collection pathway. @olivia-billing please proceed.

olivia-billing: I'll send the draft addendum and a request for a $3,735 (30%) payment link now. Pasting invoice summary for convo:```
INV-2026-1145
Amount: $12,450
Requested initial: $3,735 (30%)
Remaining: $8,715 (2 x $4,357.50)
Due: initial today, installments 30 & 60 days
```

anya-cs: I called them — they sent a screenshot of a pending bank transfer (ACH pending). They'll provide the confirmation number in chat. I'll ping here the moment it's cleared. :crossed_fingers:

marco-payments: If ACH clears, finance will mark as partial paid and legal will process addendum. If ACH bounces again, I'll open a hold ticket for eng-sre to suspend deployment access and we'll ping partnerships for recovery.

olivia-billing: Noted — moving forward with draft addendum + payment link. Will update thread with signature + payment confirmation. Thanks all.
